scene.title: Deriving the Area of a Circle
scene.summary: Visual derivation of the circle area formula π r^{2} using sector rearrangement.

beats.title: Draw circle and radius
beats.narration: We draw a circle with centre O and radius r.

beats.title: State area formula
beats.narration: The area of a circle is expressed as π r².

beats.title: Slice the circle
beats.narration: Cut the circle into many equal sectors to see its shape.

beats.title: Predict rearranged shape
beats.narration: When the sectors are rearranged, what shape do they approximate?

check.question: What shape do the rearranged sectors form?
check.explain: The sectors line up to look like a rectangle of width π r and height r.

beats.title: Form rectangle and area
beats.narration: The rearranged sectors form a rectangle of width π r and height r, giving area π r².

beats.title: Recap
beats.narration: Thus the area of a circle equals π r².
